name: authpeek
description: Chrome extension: authenticator (TOTP) with encrypted sync and auto-fill

scripts.package: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Force -Path extension/* -DestinationPath dist/authpeek.zip"
scripts.package:firefox: node scripts/build-firefox.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename authpeek-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
